subject: Launching the Joint Success Toolkit — seed doc + slides for review
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@lumina.ai>, Olivia Hart <olivia@starlane.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launching the Joint Success Toolkit — seed doc + slides for review

Hi Amit / Olivia,

Thanks again for the time today. As promised, I’m sharing a compact starter pack that combines a mutual action plan template, a proposed 21-day evaluation sprint, and a companion slide deck you can use for internal stakeholders. The goal: give your team a lightweight, executable plan to validate the integration within three weeks, with clear acceptance criteria.

What’s included (seed):
- Joint_Success_Toolkit_v1.docx — MAP template with stakeholder lanes, ownership, and acceptance matrix.
- 21d-eval-sprint-slides.pptx — week-by-week timeline, checkpoints, and demo criteria.

As you review, two asks: 1) flag anything that’s unrealistic for Lumina’s release cadence; 2) confirm primary technical reviewers and an exec sponsor we can list in the MAP.

I’ve also sketched a proposed weekly sync cadence:
- Week 0 (prep): API keys, env access, and test dataset sample delivered.
- Week 1: Integration + smoke tests; token cost baseline; initial latency checks.
- Week 2: Feature validation on 5k requests; edge-case review and quality thresholds.
- Week 3: Acceptance demo, runbook handoff, and production cutover checklist.

If you prefer, Marissa can walk through the doc and slides in a 30-minute workshop next week. Propose Wed 09/17 10:00 - 10:30 PT (or suggest an alternative).

Files attached and links below.

Thanks — looking forward to your feedback.

Best,
Irene Choi
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Joint_Success_Toolkit_v1.docx (docx), 21d-eval-sprint-slides.pptx (pptx)

Subject: Re: Launching the Joint Success Toolkit — seed doc + slides for review

Irene — thanks for putting this together, this is very helpful. Quick notes after a surface pass:

- Timeline: Week 1 looks tight given our QA backlog; can we extend the integration window by 3 days? That would give us time to run our internal test harness.
- Acceptance criteria: can we include a small suite of golden prompts (5–7) with expected outputs so our product team can validate semantic fidelity?
- Reviewers: I’ll loop in our engineering lead, Priya Desai, and product manager, Marco Li.

If we shift the week 1 window, I’m good to schedule the 30-minute doc walk-through — Thu 09/18 11:00 PT works for me.

Appreciate it — Amit
Amit Shah
Head of Integrations | Lumina.ai
amit@lumina.ai

Thanks Amit — good suggestions. I made a few edits in the Google Doc (link below) and added a 21-day sprint breakdown that shifts the integration window to allow a 3-day engineering buffer in week 1. High-level changes I made: 

- Week 1: Integration (day 1–6) — API keys, test harness run (3k requests), smoke pass.
- Week 2: Validation (day 7–14) — expanded golden prompt list (I put 6 examples), metrics to track: top-1 accuracy surrogate, hallucination incidents per 1k, 95th percentile latency.
- Week 3: Stabilize & demo (day 15–21) — run acceptance scenarios, compile runbook, and post-mortem checklist.

I also added a short slide that shows decision gates (go/no-go) and the rollback plan if latency or accuracy thresholds are missed.

Irene — I’m free Thu 09/18 11:00 PT for the walkthrough. Amit — can you add Priya and Marco to the invite so we have the right engineers on the call?

Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-Joint-Success-Toolkit (edited)

Regards,
